official_site_checks: The official paginated tag API reported 40 pages and 4,728 total entries. The bundled tag filter contains 807 entries with at least ten galleries; the freeform Tag field routes other names through the official tag search operator. The official language directory returns 14 classifications on one page. Popular artist, group, parody and character endpoints returned 120 correctly typed entries each on page 1 (277, 211, 37 and 149 pages respectively). The official search endpoint accepted artist:"ankoman" with 25 entries on its first page; the first result's detail API confirmed the matching artist tag. Source requests are paced at one per second to reduce rate-limit errors. Four sort page-1/2 probes passed in the prior live run; Home hit HTTP 429, so the complete live suite and device runtime remain unverified. Versions 18-23 add CDN requests, popular tag listings, chapter metadata and Aidoku multilingual language-filter support. A current request to /api/v2/tags/tag?sort=popular&page=1&per_page=100 returned HTTP 200 with 120 entries across 40 pages. Version 24 uses the official /api/v2/tags/tag/<slug> response to resolve tag deep links to the existing name-based Popular listing; a live lookup for big-breasts returned the canonical tag name, slug and path. Fixtures verify mapping and reject mismatched API identity, type and path. Aidoku runtime and device rendering remain unverified. Version 25 keeps the official artist tag type in Manga.artists, leaves Manga.authors empty because the API has no separate author taxonomy, and retains official group tags as description metadata; fixtures assert the split. Version 26 adds compatibility for the actual official Aidoku header/filter contract: artist names are retained in both artist metadata and the visible creator header, and creator click filters stay within the source. No additional device test is claimed. Version 27 adds an explicit Artists description line and individually clickable Artist tags, routed to exact artist queries. Sanitized user-supplied gallery 684769 metadata verifies etuzan jakusui and hayo-cinema, preserving their distinct roles. The user reports no artist header on v26; device validation of v27 is pending. Version 28 reuses gallery metadata for reader and alternate covers for up to five minutes, and successful complete filter/tag directories for up to fifteen minutes within the source instance. The first Home feed is emitted before the remaining three finish. Explicit detail refreshes still fetch current metadata; one-request-per-second pacing remains. Fixture checks cover cache expiry, cross-gallery isolation, reader/cover reuse and discovery cache hits; no device timing measurement is claimed.
